description: Fetch the full content of a single Quora answer by its URL. Returns the answer text, author info, upvote/comment/view counts, About the Author stats, and optionally the comment thread. Requires a browser session; a logged-in Quora account is recommended.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Full Quora answer URL, e.g. https://www.quora.com/<question-slug>/answer/<author-slug> or a Space subdomain answer URL.

parameters.name: include_comments
parameters.description: Set to true to also load the answer's comment thread. Comments are loaded in batches, so enabling this makes the command slower.

parameters.name: comment_limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of top-level comments to return (1-100, default 20). Only used when include_comments is true.

parameters.name: include_html
parameters.description: Set to true to also return the raw HTML of the answer body.
